crop.notes: Excerpt (crowd section) of the long Fitzsimmons-Dempsey fight report; the passage naming Allen is complete. Ends with the first line of the next paragraph.

ocr.notes: Many letter errors but names readable ('Tom Alien', 'Frea Walker').

title.suggested: Allen Backer Fred Walker at Fitzsimmons-Dempsey Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, listing the crowd at the Fitzsimmons-Dempsey fight in New Orleans, noted Fred Walker of St. Louis, who had bet on Tom Allen in his fights with Mace and others.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, January 15, 1891, page 2. The fight was Fitzsimmons vs. Dempsey, not Sullivan; current title is wrong.

notes: Only fact about Allen is that Fred Walker bet on him against Mace and others; too minor for the facts list.
